run_googletest_list_tests: run googletest-list-tests-unittest_ with args and return the list of tests printed to stdout
test_default_behavior: test the default mode behavior when gtest_list_tests flag is not set
test_flag_list_tests: test using the gtest_list_tests flag set to 0 or 1 to list tests
test_override_non_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_with_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests takes into account the gtest_filter flag for filtering tests
